questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of Fourier Symmetry?
questions.answer: Fourier symmetry shortcuts use even and odd products to remove whole families of coefficients before integrating. They save work and reduce sign errors in wave and signal calculations.

questions.prompt: What does \(f(x)\) mean in Fourier Symmetry?

questions.prompt: A centred square signal is even. Which coefficient integrals must be computed?
questions.answer: For an even function, f(x) sin nx is odd and integrates to zero on negative pi to pi. Therefore b_n=0. Only a_0 and a_n need calculation, with \[a_n=\frac{2}{\pi}\int_0^{\pi}f(x)\cos nx\,dx\]

questions.prompt: A wave displacement satisfies f(-x)=-f(x). What is the reduced coefficient formula?
questions.answer: The function is odd, so a_0 and all a_n vanish. Only sine coefficients remain, and the symmetric integral doubles the half-interval integral: \[b_n=\frac{2}{\pi}\int_0^{\pi}f(x)\sin nx\,dx\]
